audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen fields called Zoe 'he/his/him' (lint MISGENDER across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, four dosFull/dontsFull titles, dosFull[1].d and five report[N].t entries). dosFull[1].d was also tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists zoe as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to Zoe.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected to she/her. The bleed bullets rewritten to their own titles against her real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill on rows 0-4 while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Zoe — five rows rendering two answers.
audit.why: 48.4% over 376 games, and the kit backs the content layer early: Paddle Star is 800 range for 40 mana at rank 1 against your 90-mana Q, and Sleepy Trouble Bubble cuts your MR then doubles the hit that wakes you.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side moved to Zoe to match win[0..4]; those whys rewritten with her real numbers. Rows 5 and 6 already agreed as Azir.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed level 6 wins you every 2v2 with R up — but on this matchup that row belongs to Zoe in both the packet and the content layer.
audit.why: Portal Jump is 11/8/5s on a 575-range blink, so Emperor's Divide is far less of a trap against her than against an immobile mid; her one-shot pattern is still live at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now says why the wall does not yet flip it, and the Azir flip is anchored to Nashor's on row 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — what sleep actually does — was never stated. The page only said 'sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern'.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.' 18/17/16/15/14s. That is the whole reason her burst beats your shield, and it is why breaking the sleep with a soldier rather than your own body matters.
audit.corrected: The MR cut and the doubled wake-up hit now carry breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, enemyWin and breakdown.feeding.

audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Sleepy Trouble Bubble 18s, Paddle Star 8.5s, Portal Jump 11s, Azir E 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Zoe Sleepy Trouble Bubble: matchup-defining — Sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern — body-block it with minions or terrain. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shifting Sands for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18s at rank 1: it cuts your Magic Resist while asleep and doubles the hit that wakes you, so break the sleep with a soldier, not your face. - Paddle Star is 8.5s and Portal Jump 11s. - E Shifting Sands (22s) is for emergencies.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.

edits.before: If Zoe opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sleepy Trouble Bubble doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Zoe opens the score, buy Magic Resist and never break her sleep with your own body — the wake-up hit is doubled. After a second, your job is soldier-range farm and wave control.

notes: Five report[N].t entries were touched, above the two-per-matchup cap, but only as single-word pronoun corrections mandated by lintFindings MISGENDER — no report entry was rewritten. The trueDamage flag on Sleepy Trouble Bubble contradicts Riot's text (it reduces Magic Resist and doubles the breaking hit; it does not deal true damage), so nothing on the page asserts true damage — recorded as unverified. spikes[1].text says 'a completed sheen item' which is placeholder-ish, but I could not source Zoe's actual first-item build from the kits and would not guess; left alone and flagged.
